newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian truckers vote to strike.
newsitem.headline: Colombian truckers vote to strike.

text.p: Colombia's main truckers' association voted Saturday for a national strike to protest transport companies' failure to fulfil the terms of a deal hammered out last October, one of the group's leaders said.

Mario Quiroga, a member of the national directorate of the Colombian Truck Drivers' Association (ACC), which represents about 80 percent of Colombia's truckers, said the start date of the strike would be set later on Saturday.
The decision was taken at an association meeting in the southern city of Pasto.
"The strike is definite. We have taken the decision but still have not fixed the time and date. We expect to do that toward the end of the meeting Saturday," Quiroga told Reuter in a phone interview.
The association staged a crippling 11-day strike last October which virtually paralysed all Colombia's road transport and severely delayed coffee exports.
